page.layout: One printed page. Top: woodcut ornamental border (no text). Then full-width dedication heading block in italic and capitals. Below, one column of running text with a large woodcut initial Q. Faint show-through from the reverse page visible in the background, not transcribed. Page number centred at foot.

main_text.head: Nobilissimo, atque amplissimo Viro DOMINO HIERONYMO VAN BEVERNINGH, JC. Theilingæ Domino, Academiæ Lugduno-Batavæ Curatori, Reipublicæ Goudanæ Viro Consulari, multis pro Fœderato Belgio legationibus prudentissimè obitis, inclyto.
main_text.p: QUod jam pridem votis omnibus optaveram, Vir Amplissime, ut daretur mihi aliquando locus, publicè testificandi quantum tibi debeam, id in hujus opellæ limine mihi tandem videor utcunque consecuturus, si me meumque munusculum, non pro prætio operæ, sed pro dignitate operis, proque sin-

page.notes: The initial letter is a large woodcut Q, transcribed as Quod. The catchword "sin-" is the hyphenated word ending the last line. The dedication heading is split across several typographic sizes and is kept as one head. Show-through from the reverse page is not transcribed.
